display_name: CSOP SK Hynix Daily (2x) Leveraged Product

about.en: 7709 is the CSOP SK Hynix Daily (2x) Leveraged Product, a swap-based leveraged exchange-traded product managed by CSOP Asset Management as a sub-fund of CSOP Leveraged and Inverse Series and listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange since October 2025. It seeks twice the daily performance of SK hynix common shares listed on the Korea Exchange (000660), before fees and expenses. Because the leverage resets daily, returns compound and can diverge substantially from 2x the share's performance over periods longer than one day. Derivative markets quote it under the CSOPSKHYNIX2L ticker; it is not an investment in SK hynix shares themselves.
